title: Podkletnov's father, a Soviet agent, retrieved Schauberger's files

tellings.quote: he said my father was a Soviet agent and he was actually counterintel and he was tasked with retrieving a lot of Shaburgger's files.

plain: A scientist named Eugene Podkletnov is said to have explained that his father was a Soviet counterintelligence agent whose job in the 1940s was retrieving many of the files of the inventor Viktor Schauberger from Germany. Michels relays this from the writer Nick Cook's book The Hunt for Zero Point. If true, it would mean the Soviets gathered up wartime German research on unusual propulsion.
